subject: Renewal: 18-month term request + phased billing — MSA & Order Form redlines
messages:
From: Procurement - Helio Systems <procurement@helio.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: cfo@helio.com, legal@helio.com
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal ask — propose 18mo term + phased billing option

Hi Markus,

We're close on numbers and would like to propose an 18-month renewal (instead of the 12). The primary ask from Finance is to spread the committed spend across two billing tranches (50% / 50% at month 1 and month 10) rather than a single annual invoice. Legal also asked us to propose:

- a mid-term capacity uplift clause (ability to add extra reserved capacity with pro-rated pricing), and
- a softened termination for convenience during a 30-day notice after month 12, and
- clarity on audit logs/data retention tied to Private deployments.

Can you send a draft order form + suggested MSA redlines we can run by Legal? If you have a preferred DocuSign flow (signers/order), include that too.

Thanks — we want to close by end of April if possible.

— Priya Rao
Procurement Manager, Helio Systems
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Procurement - Helio Systems <procurement@helio.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal ask — propose 18mo term + phased billing option

Priya — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned to support an 18-month term with a two-tranche billing cadence and the mid-term uplift. Attached is a draft order form reflecting the 18-month term and staged billing (Helio_OrderForm_Draft_20260407.pdf).

Next steps from our side:
- Laura will propose MSA-level redlines covering the termination language, uplift mechanics, and data retention language for Private deployments.
- I'll propose a short canary-sign flow in DocuSign (customer signs Order Form, PO to follow) and include an internal SLA credit allowance for staged increases.

Do you have any internal approval constraints around the billing split (e.g., needs CFO sign-off)? If so we'll include a separate billing addendum to keep commercial and legal separate.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0178

Attachments: Helio_OrderForm_Draft_20260407.pdf
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, Procurement - Helio Systems <procurement@helio.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 08 Apr 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal ask — propose 18mo term + phased billing option

Thanks Mark — I reviewed the draft and prepared a redline set. High-level notes for Priya & Legal:

1) Term / Termination
- We can accommodate 18 months. Propose keeping the termination-for-convenience window but require a 60-day notice to avoid churn mid-billing tranche.
- If Helio wants a 30-day post-month-12 convenience termination, we'll request a pro-rata true-up clause for any committed capacity billed but not consumed.

2) Billing / Tranches
- We'll accept a 50/50 split but request the Order Form specify invoice dates and whether late payment remedies apply to tranche 2.

3) Mid-term uplift
- Add an Exhibit (Exhibit C - Capacity Uplift) that allows up to X% uplift at the then-current pricing with a 30-day notice. Any uplift will be pro-rated and billed immediately.

4) Private deployment data retention
- Add explicit language referencing our standard retention policy (90 days default, option to extend with SOW), plus an audit access clause (read-only logs for customer SOC audits).

5) SLA credits and remedies
- We'll keep standard SLA credit buckets; for longer 18-month contracts we can include an enhanced SLO target for dedicated pools.

I've attached the redlined MSA (MSA_redline_round2.docx) and a sketch of Exhibit C. Jasmine, please confirm the Exhibit wording and whether we need legal ops to route any insurer/indemnity exceptions.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: MSA_redline_round2.docx, capacity-uplift-exhibit-draft.pdf
From: Legal - Helio Systems <legal@helio.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: cfo@helio.com, procurement@helio.com
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 09:50:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal ask — propose 18mo term + phased billing option

Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and detailed redlines. A few counterpoints from Helio Legal:

- 60-day convenience notice is too long for our CFO; we can accept 45 days but need a cap on termination fees (max of 20% of remaining committed spend) to limit liability.
- For Exhibit C uplift: we need a minimum notification window of 60 days to plan capacity, and we prefer uplift billed at the start of the next full month rather than immediate billing.
- Data retention: Helio's SOC team requires a 180-day log retention baseline for Private deployments; can Redwood commit 180 days for audit logs (we're fine with S3 cold-tier if cost is an issue).

We also flagged two drafting items in the redline doc: the force majeure carve-out for cloud outages and the indemnity cap cross-ref. We can do a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through.

— Dana Myers
Senior Counsel, Helio Systems
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Legal - Helio Systems <legal@helio.com>, Procurement - Helio Systems <procurement@helio.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal ask — propose 18mo term + phased billing option

Dana — appreciate the detail. Quick responses / proposed trade-offs so we can move to signature: 

- Convenience notice: Redwood accepts 45 days (compromise). We'll add the termination true-up but cap termination fee at 15% of remaining committed spend (middle ground).
- Uplift notice: we can extend to a 60-day notice window; billing will be pro-rated and invoiced at the start of the month following effective uplift.
- Log retention: Redwood will commit to 180 days of audit log retention for Private deployments and document options for cold-tier storage to reduce cost.

If those three bullets are acceptable, Laura will push an updated redline. We can do DocuSign in a two-step flow: (1) Helio signs Order Form + Exhibit C, (2) Redwood countersigns the MSA; or if you prefer a single-package envelope we can accommodate that too.

Proposed call: Mon 13 Apr 09:00 PT (30 min) to close language. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and a DocuSign package link.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (will attach updated redline after Legal OK)
From: Procurement - Helio Systems <procurement@helio.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@helio.com, cfo@helio.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal ask — propose 18mo term + phased billing option

Markus — thanks, the trade-offs look reasonable. We're aligned on: 45-day notice with 15% cap, 60-day uplift notice with start-of-next-month billing, and 180-day log retention.

Please have Laura send the updated redline and Package link. We prefer the single-envelope DocuSign (order + MSA together) to keep the signature path simple. We'll aim to have CFO sign by Thu EOD once the DocuSign comes through.

I'll expect the calendar invite for Mon 13 Apr 09:00 PT — if anything changes I'll ping.

Regards,
Priya Rao
Procurement Manager, Helio Systems
(End of thread)
snippet: Helio requests 18-month term + 50/50 billing; Redwood proposes redlines and Exhibit C for capacity uplift. Legal trade-offs: notice windows, termination fee cap, 180-day log retention. Agreed compromise pending updated redline and DocuSign.
